description.en:
Demon King Kaon breaks the taboo and tries to bring his dead lover back to life. However, magic creates new existences beyond expectations. A little girl who looks exactly like his dead lover. However, her soul is a Korean woman named 'Lee Eun'.

The Demon King tried to kill the child as it was a failure, but he thought it was something related to the will of his deceased lover, so he made her a princess. In that way, the only being who mixed the power of the greatest magician of mankind, 'Asela' and the Demon King Kaon, 'Luciana Lord Moon Blood Lane', was born.

But that is the position of the Demon King! Lee Eun suddenly fell into another world on the day she won first prize in the lottery!

"Send me back! I could have been happy in the modern world!"

But why is this apex place more appealing? What is the prophecy of doom?

In a world full of secrets. a new life unfolds where you will meet friends and family, friendship and love that did not exist in modern times, and even the pain of the past will be healed.

---
Eun Lee has had an eventful day. First, she won the lottery. Then, she was summoned to a mystical realm by the Demon King, Kaon Mahana Lord Moon Blood Rain, and was newly named Rue, princess of the demon realm. Eun demands to be returned to her original world so she can collect her winnings, but Kaon wonders if she has something to do with his late lover’s will. Eun surprises herself by adjusting to her new and unfamiliar life, but will she ever truly let go of her past and find happiness here?

A story of growth of 20-year-old youth turns into real adults.

Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

description.en:
Julia, the Queen of Semele, has a dilemma—her childhood friend and husband, Endymion. Married through an arranged union, they’ve shared a bed for 12 years, growing up like siblings. But one day, everything changes.

“Do we really need to share a bed? You should break this habit, especially for your future concubine who’ll bear your child…”

“My child? With whom?”

Suddenly, their dynamic shifts. Endymion leans closer, locking eyes with Julia.

“My child… will be with you.”

His whisper sends shivers down her spine. Since that night, sharing a bed has become unbearably awkward.

“Can we please just use separate beds?”

description.en:
Living alone as an abandoned princess of the Kingdom of Anzak, I discovered I was in fact in a trashy novel which appeared in my dreams one day. My half-sister was the novel's heroine, while the male lead was well-known to be cruel and heartless. I was just an extra who died before all the drama started. Sold as a scapegoat for the Halvenkia Empire's peace treaty, I was destined to die, unable to escape my fate.

"I'm the only man in Halvenkia who's still single. Don't you fancy me?"

But all of a sudden, the main character wants to marry me. Your first love, first kiss, and first fling are all with the heroine, but could I take them all for myself?

Alexia, struggling to alter the story in order to survive. Tervion, wanting to keep her all for himself. And Ophelia, the unknown heroine. The original story has now begun to flow in a completely different direction. This is romance fantasy which covers Alexia and Tervion's dreams and fantasies, as the only ones in each other's eyes.

---

As the bastard child of Anzak's king, Alexia knew she was destined for very little. "The Book of Wolves" foretold her destiny as a side character, from her impoverished childhood to her brutal death at the hands of the enemy prince, Tervion. But when Alexia is sent to assassinate him, the story changes. Now she's engaged to him as part of the peace treaty between their two countries. In the face of mortal danger and abandoned by a loveless father in enemy lands, Alexia must decide where her loyalties lie and whose life matters most.

description.id:
Pada suatu hari, aku yang hidup kesepian sebagai putri kerajaan Anzac yang terbuang menyadari bahwa tempat ini adalah di dalam novel tragedi.
Tokoh utama wanita novel ini adalah adik satu ayahku, sedangkan tokoh utama prianya adalah pangeran yang terkenal kejam. Lalu, aku adalah seorang ekstra yang mati bahkan sebelum cerita ini dimulai. Demi kesepakatan perdamaian kekaisaran Halvenkia, aku yang dijual sebagai tumbal menghadapi kematianku dengan tidak berdaya seperti itu.

"Di Halvenkia, satu-satunya keluarga kekaisaran yang belum menikah hanya aku. Jangan-jangan, kamu tidak menyukaiku?"

Tapi, tiba-tiba sang tokoh utama pria mengajakku menikah.
Cinta pertama, ciuman pertama, dan malam pertamamu... semua itu adalah milik tokoh utama wanita. Apa aku boleh serakah atas dirimu?

Sekarang, cerita asli dari novel ini pun mulai berubah total.

description.ko:
앙자크 왕국의 버려진 공주로 외롭게 살아가던 나는 어느 날 벼락같이 찾아온 꿈을 통해 이곳이 피폐물 소설 속이라는 것을 알게 됐다.
여주인공은 내 이복여동생, 남주인공은 잔혹하기로 소문 난 황자.그리고 나는 극 시작도 전에 죽는 엑스트라. 하르벤키아 제국의 평화 협정을 위한 희생 양으로 팔려간 나는그렇게 속수무책으로 죽음을 앞두고 있었다.

“하르벤키아에 미혼인 황족은 나 하나라서. 설마 마음에 안 드나?”

그런데 갑자기 남주인공이 내게 결혼을 하잔다.
당신의 첫사랑, 첫 키스, 첫 잠자리는 모두 여주인공의 것인데과연 내가 당신을 욕심내도 되는 걸까?

살아남고자 소설의 내용을 바꾸려 하는 알렉시아.
그녀를 붙잡아 두고 싶은 테르뷔온.
정체를 알 수 없는 여주인공, 오필리어.
원작의 이야기는 이제 완전히 다르게 흘러가기 시작했다.

서로에게 서로가 유일한 알렉시아와 테르뷔온의 꿈과 현실을 넘나드는 로맨스판타지!

description.pt-br:
Vivendo sozinha como uma princesa abandonada do Reino de Anzak, descobri que estava de fato em um romance de merda que apareceu em meus sonhos um dia. Minha meia-irmã era a heroína do romance, enquanto o protagonista era conhecido por ser cruel e sem coração. Eu era apenas uma figurante que morreu antes que todo o drama começasse. Vendida como bode expiatório para o tratado de paz do Império Halvenkia, eu estava destinado a morrer, incapaz de escapar do meu destino. "Eu sou o único homem em Halvenkia que ainda está solteiro. Você não gosta de mim?" Mas, de repente, o personagem principal quer se casar comigo. Seu primeiro amor, primeiro beijo e primeiro caso são todos com a heroína, mas será que eu poderia ficar com tudo isso para mim? Alexia, lutando para alterar a história para sobreviver. Tervion, querendo mantê-la só para ele. E Ophelia, a heroína desconhecida. A história original agora começou a fluir em uma direção completamente diferente. Esta é uma fantasia romântica que cobre os sonhos e fantasias de Alexia e Tervion, como os únicos nos olhos um do outro.

Divine Bells - they choose their own masters and they determine the status, prestige, and influence of the countries their masters rule. The presence or lack of these Bells also has great consequence in the lives of each country's royalty. In particular, the personal and political futures of King Hong-Ryeong seem doomed without a Bell, but at equally great peril if he obtains one.

description.ar:
وفي أحد الأيام، اعترفت لي صديقة كانت بمثابة أختي البيولوجية بأنها حامل بطفل زوجي.

“مبروك يا أريانا.”

الصديق الذي، بعيدًا عن الشعور بالأسف، يتمنى بثقة البركات.

“لا تتحدث بالهراء، هل تعتقد أن الطلاق ممكن؟”

زوج وقح، على الرغم من أنه أصبح إيرلًا بصفته صهر داريل.

لقد كان زواجًا مرتبًا تم اختياره لتسوية ديون الأسرة، لكننا عملنا بجد من أجل زواجنا…

“إنه أمر لا يحتاج إلى تفكير، إنه الطلاق!”

المشكلة هي عقد الزواج مع زوجي. إذا تقدمت بطلب الطلاق أولاً، فإن العقوبة ستكون 500 مليار وون!

الإرث الوحيد الذي ورثه عن والده، الذي أنفق كل أمواله لمنع تسرب الأصول الثقافية، هو عين الأشياء الجميلة.

من نواحٍ عديدة، حان الوقت للتوصل إلى استراتيجية طلاق مذهلة!

“تطلع إلى ذلك يا روين، فسوف تسقط بطرق لم يتمكن خيالك المسكين من الوصول إليها.”
description.en:
To save her noble family from a massive 100 million debt, Ariana Astaroth marries the wealthy commoner Rowen Green, making him the new Count Astaroth in exchange. But after five years of marriage, he impregnates her best friend, and Ariana demands a divorce, stating that she'll pay him back. She goes to a guild run by a man named Rowen for help, who promises to help her escape the marriage. Can Ariana divorce her disloyal husband, or will the overwhelming debt crush her in the end?

---
One day, a friend who was like a sister to me confessed that she was pregnant with my husband's child.

"Congratulate me, Ariana."

A friend who brazenly demanded a blessing instead of feeling sorry.

"Don't talk nonsense. Do you think divorce is an option?"

A shameless husband who became a Count as a result of a marriage of convenience. Although I chose a strategic marriage to solve the family's debts, I had worked so hard for this marriage...

'Divorce is the only option without a second thought.'

The problem is the marriage contract with my husband. If I file for divorce first, the penalty is a whopping 500 billion won! The only thing I inherited from my father, who poured all his money into preventing the outflow of cultural assets, is a keen eye for beauty. It's a moment that requires an extraordinary divorce strategy!

"Just wait, Rowen. You'll fall in a way that your poor imagination couldn't even conceive."
description.fr: Ariana, fille du feu comte Astaroth voit sa vie changer le jour où la femme qu'elle considérait comme une sœur tombe enceinte de son propre mari. Ne pouvant accepter une telle trahison, elle décide de tout mettre en œuvre pour divorcer et rembourser la dette qu'elle doit à Rowen.
description.id: Setelah terpaksa menikahi rakyat biasa untuk menyelamatkan utang keluarga, Ariana Astaroth yang merupakan seorang bangsawan harus menikahi anak dari keluarga yang banyak tingkah. Seakan penderitaan tak kunjung berhenti menyapanya, Ariana kini dihadapkan dengan kenyataan bahwa adik sepersusuannya mengandung anak dari suaminya sendiri. Ingin mengakhiri kehidupan menjengkelkannya ini, Ariana ingin bangkit melawan sang suami dengan membuat rencana tuntutan perceraian epik yang diyakini sang suami tak akan bisa dilakukannya. Bagaimana rencana itu akan berjalan?
description.ko:
어느 날, 친자매 같은 친구가
내 남편의 아이를 가졌다고 고백했다.

"축하해 줘, 아리아나."

미안해하기는커녕 당당하게 축복을 바라는 친구.

"헛소리하지 마. 이혼이 가능할 것 같아?"

데릴사위로 들어와 백작이 됐음에도 뻔뻔한 남편.

가문의 빚을 해결하기 위해 선택한 정략결혼이지만,
결혼 생활을 위해 그토록 애써왔는데…….

'생각할 것도 없이 이혼이야.'

문제는 남편과의 혼인 계약이다.
먼저 이혼을 청구하면 위약금이 무려 오천억!

문화재 유출을 막기 위해 모든 돈을 쏟아 부은 아버지에게
물려받은 유산은 아름다운 걸 보는 안목 뿐.

여러모로 기가 막힌 이혼 전략이 필요한 시점이다!

"기대해, 로웬. 네 빈약한 상상력이 도달하지 못한 방식으로 추락하게 될 테니까."
description.ru:
«Поздравь меня, Ариана». Однажды моя подруга, которую я считала едва ли не родной сестрой, призналась, что носит ребенка моего мужа и, не испытывая мук совести, попросила благословения.

«Не говори ерунды! Думаешь, развод возможен?» Благодаря женитьбе мой муж стал графом, но при этом ведет себя нагло. Я очень старалась ради нашего брака, хотя и пошла на этот шаг ради покрытия долга своей семьи.

«Думать не о чем. Развод». Вся проблема в брачном контракте. Если я первой запрошу развода, то придется возместить целых 500 миллиардов! От отца, вложившего все деньги в спасение культурного наследия страны, мне досталось лишь умение видеть прекрасное.

«Подожди, Роуэн. Такое падение ты своим слабым воображением и представить не сможешь». Настало время придумать во всех смыслах потрясающую стратегию развода!
description.tr:
Bir gün, benim için kardeş gibi olan bir arkadaşım kocamın çocuğuna hamile olduğunu itiraf etti. “Beni tebrik et, Ariana.” üzülmek yerine yüzsüzce kutsanmayı talep eden bir arkadaş. “Saçma sapan konuşma. Boşanmanın bir seçenek olduğunu mu düşünüyorsun?” bunu diyen ise mantık evliliği sonucu Kont olan utanmaz bir koca.

Ailenin borçlarını halletmek için stratejik bir evlilik seçmeme rağmen, bu evlilik için çok çalışmıştım. “Hiç düşünmeden boşanmak tek seçenek”. Sorun, kocamla yaptığım evlilik sözleşmesi. Eğer boşanma davası açarsam, cezası 500 milyar won! Tüm parasını kültürel varlıkların dışarıya akmasını engellemek için harcayan babamdan bana miras kalan tek şey, güzel şeylere değer biçebilen bir göz. Olağanüstü bir boşanma stratejisi gerektiren bir an bu!

“Sadece bekle, Rowen. Zavallı hayal gücünün bile hayal edemeyeceği bir şekilde düşeceksin.”
description.zh-hk: 某一天，如親姐妹般的朋友 竟然向我坦白，自己懷上了我丈夫的孩子。 「恭喜我吧，亞莉安娜。」 她非但沒有半點歉意， 還理所當然地要求我的祝福。 「別胡說了！妳覺得有可能離婚嗎？」 明明是靠攀附我才成為伯爵的丈夫，卻一臉理直氣壯。 我當初會選擇這場政治婚姻，是為了替家族償還債務， 更為了維持婚姻生活而努力不懈……。 『根本不需要再考慮，當然是離婚。』 問題出在我們的婚姻契約。 如果我先提出離婚，就得支付五千億違約金！ 父親為了阻止文化財產流失，傾盡家產， 留給我的遺產就只剩下欣賞美麗事物的眼光。 現在正是時候， 該擬出一套絕妙的離婚策略了！ 「拭目以待吧，羅溫。 你那貧乏的想像力絕對無法預見，你將會以何等淒慘的方式墜落。」

description.en:
Reputation is everything in a world of icons and popularity contests. So why not score some points here and there by being the nice guy? This is the way Kang Shin-gi legitimizes the fake personality he has everyone believing. Armed with his above average looks and a (completely false) angel-like personality, he has every girl in school head over heels, and all the guys looking to him for guidance. With the exception of having a screwed up cross-dressing devil for a dad, Shin-gi’s life is absolute perfection (*cough* of lies), until one day, Um Seung-hui transfers to his school.  
  
While being a complete martial artist freak, she also likes to fib just a little in front of those who know her… you know, like acting like she's just a scared little girl who'd play with kittens rather than break brick walls with her head! After all, how can anything go wrong when you're as cute as Seung-hui?  
  
Fate has brought these two masters of lies together, and the two must battle it out to see who will be crowned the undefeated heavy-weight champion of fakeness!
description.it:
La reputazione è tutto in un mondo di icone e di gare di popolarità.
Per cui, perchè non segnare qualche punto qua e là facendo il ragazzo carino? Questo è il modo in cui Shingi Kang legittimizza la falsa personalità che ha fatto credere a tutti di avere.
Armato della sua ottima media sembra avere una (totalmente falsa) personalità angelica, ha tutte le ragazze della scuola ai suoi piedi, e tutti i ragazzi che lo prendono come esempio.
Con l'eccezione di avere un incasinato diavolo per padre, la vita di Shingi è la perfezione assoluta (*cough* di bugie), finchè un giorno Seunghee si trasferisce nella sua scuola.

Se da una parte è un mostro delle arti marziali, dall'altra ama raccontare piccole frottole alle persone che conosce... come ad esempio far finta di essere una piccola ragazzina spaventata che ha sempre giocato con i gattini, invece di distruggere muri di pietra con la testa!
Dopotutto, come puo' andarti storto qualcosa se sei carina come Seunghee?

Il fato ha fatto incontrare questi due maestri di vita, i due dovranno combattere per essere incoronati pesi massimi e campioni di falsità!

description.en: Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seungmin’s lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he’s also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyunje. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyunje has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seungmin knows it, he’s become yet another Ha Hyunje fanboy. Seungmin’s satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyunje, but…why is Hyunje so interested in Seungmin? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened 7 years ago have to do with anything?

And now the playboy second male lead, who is supposed to be cold, visits me all the time? Everyone's personalities seem so different, how is this story going to play out?! I just want to live a quiet homebody life!!

After waking up to find herself as the extraverted side character in the failed novel she co-wrote with a friend, introverted Adelyn is not looking to get involved in anything, including the characters' story. description.en:
Q: Can a wolf and a lion get married and have a rabbit as a kid?
A: Stop talking nonsense, wash your feet, and go to sleep.

... And just like that, I ended up in a situation where I really should just wash my feet and sleep. My dad's a lion, my mom's a wolf, and somehow, I'm a rabbit. Not just any rabbit, an extra who becomes the trigger for a war in the novel! At this rate, not only will everyone die, but both my mom's and dad's entire families will be wiped out.

'No way. I have to change my fate somehow.'

I clenched my fists and stood up determinedly, but then...

"Chloe, do you know what's for dinner tonight? That's right... rabbit meat!"

First things first, I need to make sure the wolves at home don't find out what I really am.

I thought all I had to do was hide the fact that I'm a rabbit. But a bigger problem showed up. Of all the countless special abilities among beastmen, I just had to get "being pitied." I thought this life was doomed too, but then...

"We’re not fighting. So... don't cry, okay? Please."

My parents, who even stopped a war because they were worried about me.

"Just say the word. If you want, I can kill everyone who's bullying you."

And even the original novel's male lead, who's gone a little overboard taking my side.

Honestly... stopping a war might be easier than I thought. Maybe this ability... is more useful than I realized?

description.en: Evaluated as having the lowest attribute type, F-Class, the five-year-old Shin Yu-Sung was abandoned by the famous Shin hunter family. That same year, Shin Yu-Sung was taken in by one of the top Hunters, the King of Fighters, at his orphanage. The King of Fighters, who had obtained the highest attribute type with his "physical strength" and not his attributes or other abilities, saw Shin Yu-Sung in a different light. Ninth Pulse “Your innate ninth pulse is overflowing in your body with mana! Extreme intellect! And an ethereal appearance! But you’ll die before becoming an adult…” And Yang Body Type “The energy of the Yang Body that can cure the Ninth Pulse is overflowing in your body!” In the King of Fighter’s eyes, Shin Yu-Sung only had an F-Class attribute, but is a monster born with the body and constitution that appeared once every millennium. Thus, having been abandoned by his family because of his talent, Shin Yu-Sung ironically became the King of Fighter’s pupil because of it. Twelve years passed and Shin Yu-Sung, who finished all the preparations, finally left the mountains where he had trained. Shin Yu-Sung’s strength isn’t an attribute that Hunters value but is simply his “physical strength.” A hunter, that's unlike any seen before, was born.

그리고 같은 해, 고아원에서 헌터들의 정점인 권왕을 만나 거두어 진다.
권왕은 특성이나 능력 아닌 ‘체술’로 정점에 오른 헌터.
그는 신유성의 특성이 아닌 체질에 주목한다.

구음절맥(九陰絶脈).
“네가 타고난 구음절맥은 몸에 마나가 넘쳐흐르고! 머리가 비상해지며! 천상의 외모를 가진다! 하지만 성인이 되기 전에 죽고 말지…….”

However, Carina, another reincarnated one, insists she's the true daughter. Will Rositte be able to uncover the truth about her origins, or will Carina be crowned as imperial princess instead?
___
Embodying the culture that I experienced in my previous life, a ‘reincarnator’ with the ability to make the empire flourish.

Rossite is able to use her unique ability, the power of implementation. Being bullied by the reincarnator Karina she was even accused of attempting to murder the Duke of Identino, which lead to her execution. At that moment, she recalled the memories of her past life as a paramedic, Rossite realizes that she is the real reincarnator and regresses in the brink of death. The first thing Rossite saw after her regression was Duke Identino, saying he has come to find the ‘Emperor’s lost daughter.’ Rossite goes to the imperial capital with him, but even there, Karina slanders Rossite by spreading rumors that she is a fake

가짜로 살았던 삶은 이제 끝이야.

전생에서 경험한 문물을 구현해
제국을 번성하게 하는 능력을 지닌 '환생자'.

로시테는 환생자의 고유 능력인 구현력을 쓸 수 있다는 이유로
환생자 카리나에게 괴롭힘을 당한다. 
심지어 이덴티노 공작을 살해하려 했다는 누명까지 쓰고
처형을 당하게 되는데...

그 순간 구급대원이었던 전생의 기억이 떠오르고,
로시테는 자신이 진짜 환생자라는 사실을 깨닫고 죽기 직전으로 회귀한다.

회귀한 로시테 앞에 나타난 건
'황제의 잃어버린 딸'을 찾으러 왔다며 나타난 이덴티노 공작.

로시테는 이덴티노와 함께 황도로 가지만 
그곳에서도 카리나는 로시테가 가짜 황녀라는 소문을 내며 모함하는데...
하지만 황제는 진짜라고 불리는 카리나보다
가짜 황녀로 불리는 로시테에게 더욱 마음이 간다.

'어째서 이 아이와 있으면, 황후와 있을 때처럼 편하고 즐거울까.'

description.ru:
Жизнь, которую я прожила как фальшивка, закончилась.
Реализуйте культуру и вещи, пережитые в прошлой жизни.
«Реинкарнатор», способный привести империю к процветанию.

Это потому, что Россит может использовать уникальную способность реинкарнации - силу воплощения.
Её преследует перевоплотившаяся Карина.
Её даже ложно обвинили в попытке убийства герцога Идентино.
Её казнят...

В этот момент на ум пришли воспоминания о моей прошлой жизни в качестве фельдшера.
Россит понимает, что она действительно реинкарнация, и возвращается во времена перед своей смертью.

То, тем кто появилось перед вернувшейся Россит, был герцог Идентино и говорящий, что он пришёл найти «потерянную дочь императора».

Россит отправляется в имперскую столицу вместе с Идентино, но там Карина тоже клевещет на Россит, распространяя слухи о том, что она фальшивая принцесса...
Но император понимает лучше Карины, которую называют настоящей
Меня еще больше тянет к Россит, которого называют фальшивой принцессой.

«Почему с этим ребенком так же комфортно и приятно, как с Императрицей?»

«Может ли быть, что я действительно потерянная дочь императора?»

Han Sol, a human photocopier who can draw anything she sees exactly the same!

One day, she is inspired by a picture of a mysterious genius she met in a VR game. Curious about painting in the wider world, Han Sol leaves the quiet rural village and challenges the entrance exam at Illip Art High School, the most prestigious high school in the art world, to learn painting. She enters the school after many twists and turns, and she continues to get caught up in the complicated circumstances of her friends...

The youthful growth drama of Han Sol and her friends unfolds at the picturesque Ilip Art High School!

description.ru:
Получив критические увечья после внезапного природного катаклизма, американский кореец и лоббист Пак Бен Чжун пробуждается в теле Ли Кана, второго наследника Корейской империи династии Коджона. Попав в неизведанное прошлое, он принимает четкое решение изменить судьбу, предначертанную ему. Владея информацией о будущем, он покидает Корею и, пересекая океан, прибывает в Америку.
Опираясь на историю, он пишет свою — новую и богатую — жизнь. Но одно известно точно: возвращаться он не планирует!

description.en:
From the desert wastelands emerge two mysterious warriors, master wizard Yarong and his faithful servant Batu. On a grave mission from their king, they have yet to realize the whirlwind of political movements and secret plots which will soon engulf them and change their lives forever. When Yarong is mortally injured, Batu must fulfill a secret promise to leave Yarong's side and protect his master's child. As Batu seeks to find and hide the infant, Yarong reveals another secret to those who have tracked him down to finish him off–the deadly, hidden power of a Shaman Warrior!  
  
* One of the best-selling manhwa epics of all time, Shaman Warrior recently won the Korean Culture & Content Agency's 2006 "Best Manhwa of the Year" award!

description.de: Die talentierte kaiserliche Hexe Nisha geht einen unüblichen Deal mit König Fray ein, der sie auf eine Mission schickt, um den verfluchten Großherzog des Nordens zu heilen. Dabei kommt heraus, dass der gutaussehende Herzog Lanfel schwächer und kälteanfälliger ist, als sein starkes Aussehen vermuten lässt. Während sich Nisha ihren Ermittlungen im Herrenhaus des Herzogs widmet, wird sie zeitgleich zu seiner Pflegerin. Jedoch ahnt sie nicht, dass der Deal mit König Fray dafür sorgen wird, dass sie und Herzog Lanfel sich in mehr als nur einer Sache näherkommen…
description.en:
When the talented imperial wizard Nisha makes an unconventional deal with King Frei, she goes on a mission to lift the curse of the Grand Duke of the North, Lanfel Delore!

Turns out that the dark and handsome Duke Lanfel isn't as strong as he appears to be, and it seems like the freezing gray days of winter is a bit too much for the Duke's frail body. While Nisha does her research around the Duke's manor to lift his curse, she simultaneously becomes his caretaker. Little does she know that her deal with King Frei could bring her and Duke Lanfel together in more ways than one...
description.fr: Le grand-duc du Nord est un homme beau, ténébreux... et très frileux. L'enchanteresse Nisha est envoyée chez lui pour lever la malédiction dont il serait victime depuis la mort de la traîtresse Rosanne. Nisha n'a pas le choix: elle se doit de rentrer à nouveau dans les bonnes grâces de l'empereur, après avoir été elle-même soupçonnée de trahison! Finalement, elle ne se trouve pas si mal dans le Nord... Elle y trouve même l'occasion d'user de toute son inventivité... pour réchauffer le grand-duc!
description.id: Aku juga tidak menyangka aku akan merasuk ke novel romansa fantasi. Akan tetapi, aku baru mendapatkan ingatan dari kehidupan sebelumnya setelah 25 tahun berada di dunia novel ini. Untungnya, ingatan itu kembali sebelum perang perebutan takhta kaisar terjadi. Oleh karena itu, untuk menghindari konflik besar tersebut, aku kabur dari istana kaisar selama satu tahun. Tapi, setelah kembali aku malah diberi hukuman untuk melepaskan kutukan seorang Archduke.
description.ja:
宮廷魔法師ニーシャはある日突然前世の記憶を取り戻し、そこが前世で読んでいた小説の世界で直に皇位争奪戦が起こることを知る。
ニーシャはすぐさま皇宮を離れ、抗争が終わった１年後にようやく戻ってくるとそこには皇帝が待ち構えていた。しかも悪女ロザンナの一味と勘違いされ…

「半年の間に北部大公の呪いを解くことができたら処刑を免除しよう」

そうして仕方なく向かった先に待っていたのは――

「…寒いです、ニーシャ」
異常に寒がりなイケメン大公で!?
大公邸で共に過ごしながら次第に縮まる２人の距離…彼らが迎える結末とはいったい!?
description.ko:
피폐 로판 소설 빙의 20년차 황궁 마법사 니샤.
원작에 휘말리지 않기 위해 도망치려다 황제에게 붙잡혀 도리어 사형 위기에 처한다.
마녀의 저주에 걸린 북부대공의 비밀을 알아내면 살려주겠다는 황제의 제안에 따라 혹한의 영지로 향하고, 그곳에서 소문난 냉혈한이자 "몹시 추위를 타는" 북부대공을 만나게 되는데...
description.uk: Талановита імперська чарівниця Ніша укладає незвичну угоду з королем Фреєм та відправляється на місію зняти прокляття з Великого Герцога Півночі Ланфела Делора! Виявляється, смаглявий і красивий герцог Ланфел не такий сильний, як здається, і схоже, що морозні сірі зимові дні занадто важкі для слабкого тіла герцога. Поки Ніша досліджує садибу герцога, щоб зняти його прокляття, вона одночасно стає його доглядачкою. Вона навіть не підозрює, що її угода з королем Фреєм може нерчікувано зблизити її з герцогом...
description.zh-hk: 皇宮魔法師妮莎某天突然想起前世的記憶，得知了自己身處的世界是前世讀過的小說中，而這裡不久後就會興起一場皇位爭奪戰。 於是妮莎立刻離開了皇宮避風頭。一年後鬥爭結束，她又回到宮中時，皇帝像是有備而來地直指她和叛亂的禍首惡女洛詹娜是一夥的… 「妳只要在半年內解開大公的詛咒，那我就赦免妳的死罪。」 逼不得已前往大公的所在處之後，竟碰上―― 「…妮莎，我好冷……」 異常怕冷的帥大公?! 在大公宅邸共同生活，逐漸拉近了兩人的距離……他們倆將會迎向什麼樣的結局?!

마나를 깨웠지만 처참한 재능으로 3년간 빚을 내며 배운 마법은 손 닦는 기술뿐.  
결국 가문은 몰락, 하녀로 전락한다.

Hwa-Won knows better than to pick things off the street, even if it is just an innocent-looking USB. In an effort to find the owner, Hwa-Won discovers that the USB belongs to her favorite GL writer, Kim Yuri, and has unreleased chapters of the latter’s new sequel! As a zealous fan, Hwa-won can hardly resist herself from devouring the chapters in one setting. However, she seems to have forgotten that curiosity is not just hazardous to cats! Because the USB doesn’t just contain the chapters to the sequel. It also contains things that leave Hwa-Won upset. Now Hwa-Won needs answers and Kim Yuri’s the only one who has them. But Kim Yuri is a staunch recluse who refuses to leave her house! How is Hwa-Won to meet her?! Soon, online meets offline, fiction meets reality and as the pages turn, it is no longer Hwa-Won doing the chasing!

The only way to counter these codes is to play their own game. An awkward mesh of men with different motives are recruited to fight. How is everything going to end?

The Gerrard family has been loyal to the royal family for 1,000 years. But the royal family returned that loyalty for thousands of years with a slap in the face. Adelia Gerard, who lost all her family, lineage and loved ones to the crown prince. She fell asleep while determined to take revenge on the crown prince who killed a loved one. When she opened her eyes, she saw the dead living in front of her eyes. “Dream?” No, this is an opportunity for Adelia. A hidden secret. Can she change everything and live happily ever after? “Do you want to live with me? If you agree, I will take good care of you.” “Yes?” The story is about a man pretending to be a bear and a cute girl who thinks she is a fox.

Once a hardcore player, now drowning in debt in his tiny room.

His long-awaited showdown with a demon lord ends in an unexpected failure.

The debt collectors are closing in... and all that's left to him are despair and stubborn grit.

Katya, the notorious villainess from the southern region, declares her opposition to marriage! The Duke sets up an intense showdown with his daughter, who rejects every suitor that comes her way. Caught in a crisis of being forced into marriage with the scoundrel Petrozsky, Katya decides to make her escape. During her escape, she ends up spending an unexpected night with a man she encounters… He turns out to be the tyrant Grand Duke Nikolai de Vasily. In her attempt to avoid one madman, she becomes entangled with an even crazier one!

Is this a choice based on reality? Don’t tame the tomboy. She’s pretty enough the way she is.

---
**A Fierce Encounter Between the Villainess and the Tyrant: The Sweet Pursuit of a Ruthless Romance**
*“How dare someone like you even dream of courting me? I'd rather stay single for life than settle for someone like you!”*

Katia, the notorious villainess of the southern territories, declares a life of singlehood! Suitors are turned away at her door, one after another. But her father, the duke, takes drastic action to change her mind. Facing the threat of an unwanted marriage, Katia tries to escape…

*“I’m busy, so don’t annoy me. Move along, will you?”*

*“Were you talking to me just now?”*

*“Well, who else here would I be talking to?”*

The man she meets? None other than Basil, the grand duke and a tyrant rumored to be mad. Escaping one madman, she finds herself tangled with an even crazier one!

*“The moment you dismissed me, I felt as if my heart stopped.”*

*“Then maybe you should see a doctor?”*

*“Only someone like you could possibly handle someone as insane as I am.”*

*“Are you looking for a wife or… a caretaker?”*

*“With you, I think I could have both.”*

Everywhere she turns, it’s madmen all around. Is this really her only choice?

*“If I ask for a divorce, you’d probably kill me, wouldn’t you?”*

*“And what exactly would I gain from that?”*

*“I don’t know… a sense of conquest?”*

*“Actually, I’d rather you conquered me.”*

*“Are you sure I’m fit to be the duchess?”*

*“I love you just as you are. Does that answer your question?”*

*“Don’t try to tame a spirited woman. She’s beautiful just as she is.”*

A tyrant completely captivated by the charms of a wicked woman—a crazy, relentless romance unfolds.

description.en:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

Ваш брат, единственный член вашей семьи, потерял всю память. Он удивленно спрашивает: «У меня есть брат? Ты kidding?». С этого момента, после того как он вывел тебя из храма, его поведение изменилось. Он стал непонимающим и неуклюжим, как будто не способен позаботиться о себе. Я не хотел быть бременем для человека, который совсем ничего не помнит обо мне. В какой-то момент я понял, что не могу оставаться рядом и решил уйти, оказавшись наедине с ужасом последующих испытаний. Поэтому я решил вмешаться в события прошлого, вернувшись в момент, когда мой брат потерял память.

Теперь его лицо стало еще более растерянным, и он произнес: «Я понятия не имею, что теперь делать, ведь в голове у меня пустота». Я вмешался: «Да, сейчас у тебя нет никаких воспоминаний». В этот момент, чтобы как-то наладить общение, я достал заранее подготовленную бумагу, на которой большими, неровными буквами было написано: «Я передаю всё свое имущество своему брату». В этот раз я твердо заявил: «С этой жизни я буду защищать тебя, так что прими это».
